title: 疑问句的四种结构
explanation: 疑问句是用来提出问题的句子。和汉语一样，英语的疑问句句尾要用问号。英语的疑问句分为一般疑问句、特殊疑问句、选择疑问句和反义疑问句四种。

examples.en: Did he pass the text yesterday?
what are they doing in the lab?
Would you like coffee or (would you like) juice?
Which do you prefer,talk shows or soap operas?
William is an exchange student，isn't he?
We don't have classes today, do we?
